**Key observations from the test image:**
- Classic **V-shaped yellowing** widest at the leaf margin, tapering inward
- Brown necrotic tissue at the tip/margin
- Gradual green-to-yellow-to-brown transition from base to tip
- No discrete spots, no concentric rings, no mold/spore growth, no bronzing

The KB description for Verticillium Wilt matches perfectly: *"V-shaped leaf lesions widest at the leaf margin, brown necrotic tissue surrounded by irregular yellowing."* No other class describes this exact V-shaped marginal yellowing pattern. While the Verticillium reference showed general wilting, the test image's diagnostic V-shaped chlorosis is the textbook hallmark of this disease.
